pages.title: Making Inolashite
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Alduorite + 1 Ceruclase = 2 Inolashite

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 1028 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 6.$(br)Mining efficiency: 7.2.$(br)Material damage bonus: 5.0.$(br)Enchantability: 22.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 5, chestplate 7, leggings 6, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 1.0.$(br)Enchantability: 22.

pages.title: Weapon: Time Cleave
pages.text: When attacking, another attack will be time-collapsed to your first attack allowing you to attack two times at full power in quick succession.

pages.title: Tool: Time Leap
pages.text: Upon activation, transports the player 7 blocks in the direction they are looking breaking all the blocks in the way (as long as the tool can harvest them).

pages.title: Armor: Warp
pages.text: Shift + Jump will teleport the player back in time of 2..8 seconds depending on how much armor is worn
